patterns.note: Full-bleed project showcases with large, impactful imagery and minimal text overlays, creating an immersive portfolio experience.
Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif typography is used for project titles and hero statements, often spanning the full width of the screen, contrasting with a more refined serif for the brand name.
A monochromatic base palette of black, white, and various shades of grey dominates the UI, allowing vibrant project imagery to provide the primary color accents.

The initial large hero text scrolls up and out of view, while a minimalist header bar at the bottom of the hero section transforms into a sticky, more prominent header with the studio name and navigation as the user scrolls down.
Project sections are presented as distinct, full-screen visual blocks, often featuring a single large image or video, creating a strong visual rhythm down the page.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed visual (image or video) with oversized, bold text overlaid. This text scrolls away with the page, revealing subsequent content.

A minimalist navigation bar, initially positioned at the bottom of the hero section, transforms into a fixed, slightly more prominent header with the brand name and navigation links once the user scrolls past the hero content.

Content sections and project images are introduced with a subtle scroll-triggered animation, such as a fade-in or slight vertical slide, as they become visible in the viewport, enhancing content discovery.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~5-10x body) for hero and project titles, with a contrasting elegant serif for the brand name, and smaller, lighter sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy; particularly in the hero and between project sections, with a balanced density in the footer and client logo grid.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely large, almost architectural typography for project titles, often filling the screen, creates a powerful and memorable visual impact. This, combined with a stark monochromatic UI, ensures the creative work itself is the absolute focal point.
